entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: info expects 1 or 2 arguments, got %d
entries.rationale: The PromQL parser pins info() arity via Variadic:1 over a two-vector ArgTypes signature, so a call with zero or three-plus arguments is rejected at parse time and never reaches lowering.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: info(...) second argument must be a label selector, got %T
entries.rationale: The reference engine's evalInfo itself type-asserts args[1] to *parser.VectorSelector; a non-selector vector second argument is not a meaningful info label-selector and the guard mirrors that upstream assumption rather than panicking on the cast.
